title: Report On V.B. Stepennoff Alias V.V. Stepanoff And P.M. Ushakoff

page_data.en:
CONFIDENTIAL
DRAWER

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No I. O. D. 1131
Date 31 - 3 - 30

March 31, 30.

Dear Hill,

With reference to your memorandum of
March 28, 1930, inquiries show that V.B. Stepanoff
alias V.V. Stepanoff has three previous convictions
as follows:-

(1) Charged at the Provisional Court with the assault
on August 3, 1926 and fined $3.00.

(2) Charged at the French Mixed Court on October 24,
1927 for stealing a motor car from the public
roadway and breaking into a garage, and sentenced
to 2 months' imprisonment.

(3) Charged at the French Mixed Court on April 11,
1928 with larceny and sentenced to 3 days' imprisonment.

There is nothing in the records of the
Municipal Police concerning M. Usakoff.

Yours sincerely,

J. C. Hill Esq.,
H.B.M. Consulate-General,
Shanghai.
page_data.zh:
机密
卷宗

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记室
编号 I. O. D. 1131
日期 30年3月31日

1930年3月31日。

希尔先生：

关于您1930年3月28日的备忘录，经查询，V.B. Stepanoff（又名 V.V. Stepanoff）此前有三次定罪记录，如下：

(1) 1926年8月3日在临时法院被控殴打罪，罚款3.00元。

(2) 1927年10月24日在法国会审公廨被控从公共道路盗窃汽车并闯入车库，判处监禁2个月。

(3) 1928年4月11日在法国会审公廨被控盗窃罪，判处监禁3天。

工部局警务处档案中并无关于 M. Usakoff 的记录。

此致

J. C. Hill 先生，
英国驻上海总领事馆，
上海。

File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Foreign Section. Station,
REPORT
Date March 29, 1930.
Subject (in full) V.B. Stepennoff and P.M. Ushakoff.
Made by D.S. Maklaevsky. Forwarded by [Signature]
With reference to the attached letter of March 28,
1930 from H.B.M. Consulate General re: V.B. Stepennoff and
P.M. Ushakoff, inquiries show that V.B. Stepennoff, alias
V.V. Stepanoff is a common thief and has four previous
convictions against him.
(1) Was charged at the Provisional Court with the assault
on August 3rd, 1926 and fined $3.00.
(2) Was charged at the Provisional Court with the larceny
on August 20, 1927 but the case was dismissed.
(3) Was charged at the French Mixed Court on October 24,
1927 for stealing a motor car on the public roadway
and breaking into garages, and was sentenced to
2 months' imprisonment.
(4) Was charged at the French Mixed Court on April 11,
1928 with larceny and sentenced to 8 days' imprisonment.
There is nothing in the Municipal Police records
concerning P.M. Ushakoff.
（左侧手写批注：29/3 30.）
B. Maklaevsky.
D. S.
A/D. C. I. Reg. Letter in accordance with
draft underneath.
[Signature]
29/3/30.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
外侨科。分局，
报告
日期 1930年3月29日。
事由（全称） V.B. Stepennoff 和 P.M. Ushakoff。
呈报人 D.S. Maklaevsky。转呈人 [签名]
关于附上的英国总领事馆1930年3月28日来信，涉及 V.B. Stepennoff 和 P.M. Ushakoff，经查询，V.B. Stepennoff（又名 V.V. Stepanoff）系惯窃，此前共有四次定罪记录。
(1) 1926年8月3日在临时法院被控殴打罪，罚款3.00元。
(2) 1927年8月20日在临时法院被控盗窃罪，但案件驳回。
(3) 1927年10月24日在法国会审公廨被控在公共道路盗窃汽车并闯入车库，判处监禁2个月。
(4) 1928年4月11日在法国会审公廨被控盗窃罪，判处监禁8天。
工部局警务处档案中并无关于 P.M. Ushakoff 的记录。
（左侧手写批注：30年3月29日。）
B. Maklaevsky.
D. S.
助理刑事侦缉处长。根据下方草稿拟函。
[签名]
30年3月29日。
